verdict.rationale: Chroma's own site lists sparse vector search for lexical BM25/SPLADE retrieval. Its docs show `.query` can combine dense similarity with `where_document` full-text `$contains`/`$regex` matching, but that matching acts as a filter, not a scored lexical signal. Nothing shows dense and sparse scores being fused in a single hybrid query. Missing for 10: documented hybrid dense+sparse query API, fusion ranking (e.g. RRF or weighted score combination), in-depth docs on sparse/BM25 usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote: Sparse vector search - Lexical search (BM25, SPLADE)
.get and .query can handle where_document search combined with metadata filtering
We support full-text search with the `$contains` and `$not_contains` operators.
